GO for exactly one bounded L40S causal-depth runtime and backend measurement. The tested implementation identity is 331ecf58aead9648530e1af271c5e233577a3775: full suite 1914 passed / 11 skipped / 0 errors, pod simulator 1874 passed with the artifact tree restored exactly, frozen-asset verifier passed. covers: One (1) bounded causal-depth runtime and backend measurement on a single NVIDIA L40S at no more than $0.99/h, running exactly the reviewed job with its reviewed defaults: 3 deterministic samples at each skip cardinality 1-8, weighted extrapolation over the real 36,35,...,29 schedule, the production _ReferenceLogits cache policy unchanged, teacher revision 768f209d9ea81521153ed38c47d515654e938aea, the production peak captured before the comparison and the production cache released before E8a, E8a with cache_reference=False, exactly two backend pairs (|skip|=1 and |skip|=8), and utilization sampling enabled. does_not_authorize: Phase-A attempt 11 or any Phase-A attempt. Greedy search, depth-map selection, checkpoint writing, or any follow-on run - the session names SpendAuthorization, whose allows_phase_a is a hard False, so this is a property and not only a prohibition. fail_closed_instruction: Stop and tear down with provider confirmation if any per-item backend delta is non-zero, the job OOMs, the production reference cache falls back to recompute in a way that materially changes the cost basis, or the hard ceiling is approached. Collect the evidence first: the report is written before either stop.
on_completion: Collect the artifact, delete the pod with provider confirmation, and stop. Report mean seconds per cardinality, the weighted 260-evaluation runtime and evaluations/min, the deliberately wrong flat-cardinality-8 figure, the production cache decision, production peak VRAM, comparison peak separately, the GPU utilization distribution, E8a-vs-port per-item deltas for both pairs, the exact hardware/image/library/model/calibration identities, and actual wall time and spend.
